top.title: Mother Dairy hikes milk prices by ₹2-4 per litre in Delhi-NCR from November 12: Check new rates
top.description: Mother Dairy has increased milk prices by ₹2-4 per litre from November 12, citing higher procurement costs. Full cream milk now costs ₹76 per litre, while toned milk is priced at ₹60-62 per litre in Delhi-NCR.

top.title: Alice Huang used her relationship with Jensen Huang to move 240,000 Nvidia chips worth $7.5 billion to China: Report
top.description: Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive, is alleged to have assisted a network of companies in acquiring and redirecting restricted Nvidia chips to China estimated to be worth $7.5 bn. Separately, Malaysian authorities seized 30 server units containing advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur Airport.

top.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
